 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• Vitamins are required for the** body to work properly**.
 
• There are** 13 essential vitamins**. They are:
 
 
• Vitamin A
 
• Vitamin C
 
• Vitamin D
 
• Vitamin E
 
• Vitamin K
 
• Vitamin B1 (thiamine)
 
• Vitamin B2 (riboflavin)
 
• Vitamin B3 (niacin)
 
• Vitamin B6 (pyridoxine)
 
• Vitamin B12 (cyanocobalamin)
 
• Pantothenic acid (B5)
 
• Biotin (B7)
 
• Folate (folic acid or B9)
